transcript.text: My fridge freezer has been making a funny smell in the kitchen the last couple of days, I've cleaned it out but it's still there. Any ideas?

A persistent smell after cleaning often suggests a component like the evaporator fan motor or its housing is harbouring mould, or there may be an electrical issue causing a burning odour. Since emptying it didn't help, we need to identify exactly which part might be involved. Could you please provide the make and model number? This is usually found on a sticker inside the fridge, often on a side wall near the salad drawer. If you can't reach that label right now, don't worry about it for now.
[Safety panel] An appliance that keeps tripping your electrics — or that smells of burning or has scorch marks — may have an electrical fault. Stop using it, switch it off and unplug it, don't keep resetting it, and have it checked by a qualified electrician or appliance engineer.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]

The label inside the fridge says CDA543FS, it's a Beko. The serial number starts with 04. The smell is a bit like hot plastic, more at the back than inside, and I've noticed the plug feels a bit warm too.

⚠ Stop using this appliance
A burning or hot-plastic smell, smoke, scorching or melting can mean an electrical fault or a fire risk. Stop using it, switch it off and unplug it (or turn it off at the fuse box), and don't run it again — not even as a test — until it has been checked by a qualified engineer. That warm plug and hot plastic smell are classic signs of an electrical fault, often caused by a failing compressor start relay or overheating wiring at the back. Because this is a fire hazard, it must be isolated from the mains immediately and left unplugged until a qualified engineer has checked it. You can safely check if there's any visible scorching around the plug or socket while it's switched off, but do not attempt to open the appliance yourself. Please arrange for a professional repair as soon as possible.
